sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(customerNumber) FROM customers WHERE creditLimit <= 100000 AND customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', paymentDate) = '2004')), T1.customerName FROM customers T1 JOIN payments T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.creditLimit <= 100000 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.paymentDate)='2004' GROUP BY T1.customerNumber, T1.customerName ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(T1.productCode) FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T2.MSRP - T2.buyPrice > 100
SELECT SUM(T1.amount) FROM payments T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.paymentDate)='2003' AND T2.creditLimit = 0
SELECT COUNT(T2.country) FROM orders T1 JOIN customers T2 ON T1.customerNumber=T2.customerNumber WHERE T1.status='Shipped' AND T2.country='France' GROUP BY T2.customerNumber HAVING COUNT(T1.status)=2
SELECT T1.email FROM employees T1 JOIN offices T2 ON T1.officeCode=T2.officeCode WHERE T2.city='Sydney' AND T1.jobTitle LIKE '%Sales Manager%'

SELECT T2.firstName, T2.lastName, T3.firstName, T3.lastName FROM customers T1 JOIN employees T2 ON T1.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T2.employeeNumber JOIN employees T3 ON T2.reportsTo=T3.employeeNumber JOIN payments T4 ON T1.customerNumber=T4.customerNumber ORDER BY T4.amount DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.productName, T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode JOIN orders T3 ON T1.orderNumber=T3.orderNumber JOIN customers T4 ON T3.customerNumber=T4.customerNumber JOIN employees T5 ON T4.salesRepEmployeeNumber=T5.employeeNumber JOIN offices T6 ON T5.officeCode=T6.officeCode WHERE T6.city='Boston' AND T5.jobTitle='Sales Rep' ORDER BY T1.quantityOrdered * T1.priceEach DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT phone FROM customers WHERE contactLastName LIKE 'M%' AND country != 'Germany'
SELECT SUM(amount)/COUNT(customerNumber) FROM payments WHERE paymentDate >= '2004-01-01' AND paymentDate < '2004-07-01'
SELECT (T2.MSRP - T1.priceEach)/T2.MSRP FROM orderdetails T1 JOIN products T2 ON T1.productCode=T2.productCode WHERE T1.productCode='S18_3482' AND T1.orderNumber=10108
